dogecoin.text:
$SHIB has surpassed the market capitalization of $DOGE, according to CoinGecko. 

#Shibainu trading at $0.00007851, up 58.6% in the last 24 hours and 179.5% in the past week, giving it a market cap of $39.2 billion, the 9th most among cryptocurrencies.

The price of #ShibaInu surged 33% to reach an ATH of $0.00005478. The record price represents a near doubling of the value of the Shiba Inu coin in the past week.

In terms of market capitalization, $SHIB is now worth $27 billion, while $DOGE market cap stands at $31.44 billion.
